front.title: On Calculating and Updating the Internet Checksum

abstract.t: Over the past four decades, the Internet checksum has been used by many protocols: IPv4, TCP, UDP, and others. The practical details related to calculation and updates are scattered across different RFCs. Several protocols introduce special-case handling for +0 and -0, thus making the term "Internet checksum" ambiguous. This affects any protocol implementation which modifies the data covered by any variant of the Internet checksum. This document provides the problem statement and outlines the scope for potential future work to build a consolidated source for the Internet checksum. If there is interest in such work, this document may be converted into that consolidated specification.
